hypothesis: H77 native posture with bounded measured-contact force allocation under the combined individual motor ceilings may reconcile requested wrench and achievable command. A copied shared support state replaces assumed future support in candidate forecasts.

allocation.variables: Three components per qualified measured sole resultant at its measured centroid; canonical segment ordering; no new-contact minimum share.
allocation.objective: Squared force error / bodyweight^2 + squared moment error / (bodyweight * COM-height)^2 + 0.02 squared change from surviving admissible forces / bodyweight^2 + 0.02 squared combined motor utilization. H77 posture request keeps its existing division by 1.02.
allocation.normalization: Force/bodyweight, moment/(bodyweight * max(0.4m, COM-height)), motor/individual existing axis ceiling.
allocation.projection: At most 64 gradient iterations, each at most 24 cyclic convex projection sweeps. Report convergence and residual; reject constraint violations above 1e-5 normalized units. Final motor command clamps only tolerance-sized residual to the unchanged ceiling.
allocation.limits: Existing total normal 1.35 BW, friction1.2, measured-support horizontal acceleration cap, and every combined posture/contact motor ceiling. No changed physical settings.

prediction.model: Copy the serializable support state; shared deterministic target/readiness/contact update; hold latest admissible force and measured loads. Do not invent future retained-support growth. Conservative unvalidated model; no readiness prediction for infeasible requests.
prediction.measuredLaunch: Retained >=52% BW, moving <=25% BW for 0.10s continuously. Retained contacts also keep existing 0.05s persistence. Prediction never authorizes launch.

failurePolicy.successor: Preserve first complete failure; H79/H80 permitted only for the earliest demonstrated defective stage. No tuning in acceptance or fourth candidate.
